description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four variants of the DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) model, measured by MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10), as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at each whole number from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” spans from 33.0 to 36.0 in increments of 0.5. Four distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains constant at approximately 34.3 across all S values; “DPR w/ corpus expansion” (red line with circle markers) starts at 35.1 when S=1, rises to a peak of 35.8 at S=6, then slightly declines to 35.7 at S=10; “DPR w/ document expansion” (green line with triangle markers) begins at 34.8, fluctuates slightly around 34.9–35.0, and ends at 34.8; and “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” (blue line with diamond markers) starts at 34.8, peaks at 35.0 at S=2, dips to 34.6 at S=6, and declines further to 34.4 at S=10. The legend is positioned in the lower right corner, clearly identifying each line by color, marker, and label.
